subject: Roads Engineer application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Walgett Shire Council People and Culture Team,

I'm applying for the Roads Engineer role that I saw on SEEK.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections and quality checks, tracking materials and writing progress reports.

Your advert describes road projects from investigation and scoping through to construction, maintenance and flood restoration across the Shire, which is the practical roads work I want to build my career on. I'm based in Melton VIC, open to discussing relocation to Walgett, and I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked on Australian road projects or with Transport for NSW standards yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

subject: Civil Engineering Technician application, Marc Masarate

Hello LGC Traffic Management team,

I'm applying for the Civil Engineering Technician role in Midvale that I saw on SEEK.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and coursework on Austroads guides and AS 1742.14. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge, doing site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring and keeping site records.

Your advert asks for a civil diploma and AutoCAD to prepare traffic guidance schemes and support site inspections, permits and project records, which fits where I want to start. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth. I hold an Australian driver's licence, a White Card and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked in traffic management or used GIS or Main Roads WA standards on a job yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
